notes:
Context: mid-market sales enablement SaaS. Heavily outbound-focused; core product is an SDR productivity layer used by enterprise SMB customers.

Decision makers: Maya Gonzalez (VP Product), Liam Huang (Head of Eng), Nora Patel (Head of RevOps).

POC / technical asks:
- End-to-end streaming chat agent that can make reliable tool calls: 1) create CRM activity (Salesforce), 2) send draft email + send via Gmail API, 3) schedule meeting (Google Cal / Office365).
- Latency SLO: time-to-first-token / streaming continuity p95 target <= 300ms for NA; p50 goal < 150ms.
- Throughput/scale: expected daily volume ~30k conversations, concurrency target 60-100 live agent sessions during peak; burst to 200.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget — want hosted API price for trial then estimate Dedicated commit if unit economics improve by >=20%.
- Quality guardrails: function/tool-call confirmation messages, idempotency checks for CRM writes, retry/backoff on failures.

Quotes / call notes: "If streaming feels snappy and tool-calls are reliable, we can move to a committed Dedicated pool for predictable cost." — Maya.

Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), customer-managed KMS preferred, audit logs surfaced in Console or exported. Data residency for some customers (US-only) is required.

Open items: detailed p95 streaming numbers in EU region; quantized/cheaper model options for 2x cost reduction; legal redlines on data retention.

Next actions (internal): finalize performance tuning plan with Runtime team (kernel selection, batching settings), add routing policy for NA priority, schedule pricing + procurement review week of 2026-03-08.
